verdict.rationale: Retention and deletion controls are a fair axis for an observability platform that stores logs, metrics and traces. However, the evidence pack never describes retention periods, retention policies, or deletion of stored telemetry. Related items only cover where data is stored (Loki chunks in S3/GCS or a local filesystem, Mimir long-term storage) or cost-driven aggregation (Adaptive Telemetry), and none of these show user-controlled retention or deletion.
